page.notes: Printed text is fully transcribed. Doubtful readings: "com-muniri" (the u may be read as a in print, so muniri is likely), "auemus" (kept as printed), "quotis" (as printed). The Greek asterisk mark before "Espencaeo" is treated as the reference mark for the note "Supra cap. 5." Chapter number in the running head reads "Cap.6." as printed. Small ornament at lower left is not text and is omitted.
